title: Workflow Model Policy Overlay v1
description: Operator-editable, validated JSON overlay that selects per-workflow / per-step model profiles. Missing file = library defaults; an invalid file blocks workflow execution (missing != invalid). D-2: only the 'default' context overlay is honored this release; the 'contexts' shape reserves per-context overlays for a future release but a non-'default' key is inert.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this overlay (recorded in the run snapshot's overlay_id). Defaults to 'default'.

contexts.description: Per-context overlays. D-2: only the 'default' key is honored/validated this release; other keys are reserved (inert).

workflows.description: Per-workflow overrides keyed by workflow id (e.g. 'implementation').

steps.description: Per-step profile id, keyed by step label (e.g. 'implement'). The value is a built-in model-profile id valid for the step's harness.
